name: Horde Convoy: Zombie Shooter
summary: Horde Convoy is an action shooter for Android with crowd-runner elements. The player steers a squad of soldiers along a three-lane road while it fires automatically, choosing arithmetic gates (+, −, ×, ÷) that grow or shrink the squad up to 300 soldiers. Zombie hordes and telegraphed boss attacks fill 30 story levels told through painted comics, followed by endless patrols. Power-ups (Shield, Rapid Fire, Airstrike, Magnet), perks and weapon upgrades shape each run. Single-player, playable offline, free with optional rewarded ads.
